single.note: Single-threaded: the `lzbench24_x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc15` release binary (gcc 15.2.0) with `-eALL -t8,8 -o1c4` on one thread of an AMD EPYC 9555P at 3.20 GHz, governor `performance`, turbo boost off, Ubuntu 26.04, `silesia.tar`.

multi.note: Multi-threaded: the same binary and machine with `-eALL -b4096 -T# -t8,8 -o1c4`, pinned to # cores with `taskset`. The input is split into 4 MB blocks compressed independently, so compressed sizes are slightly larger than single-threaded and the same for every thread count. crush and tornado are left out because they have no multithreading.
